headline: Tech Equities Tumble on AI Spending Doubts and Persistent Inflation Concerns
summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq closed sharply lower as semiconductor shares dropped. Investors questioned high artificial intelligence capital expenditure following Meta's spending and Middle East tension concerns.
why: Megacap tech and chipmakers have driven global index gains; reassessments of return on capital for AI hardware heavily sway benchmark equity performance.

impacts.name: US Semiconductors
impacts.why: Growing scrutiny on enterprise AI capital intensity is dampening high-multiple tech valuations.

why_moved: Resurfacing doubts regarding returns on massive AI capital investments led to widespread selling across chipmakers and tech indices.
